verses.eng: "This then, my Adanay, is the solution of the song which Pistis Sophia has uttered."

It came to pass then, when the First Mystery had heard Mathathayahaw speak these words, that he said: Well said, Mathathayahaw, and finely, beloved. This is the solution of the song which Pistis Sophia has uttered."
And the First Mystery continued again and said:

Sophia continues to sing. "'1. I will declare: You are the higher Light, for that have saved me and led me to you, and you have not let the emanations of Self-willed, which are hostile to me, take my light. "'2. O Light of lights, I sing praises to you; you have saved me. "'3. O Light, you have led up my power out of the chaos; you have saved me from them which have gone down into the darkness.'

"These words again has Pistis Sophia uttered, Now, therefore, whose mind has become understanding, comprehending the words which Pistis Sophia has uttered, let him come forward and set forth their solution."

Marayam is afraid of Kayapaa. It came to pass then, when the First Mystery had finished speaking these words to the disciples, that Marayam came forward and said: "My Adanay, my mind is ever understanding, at every time to come forward and set forth the solution of the words which she has uttered; but I am afraid of Kayapaa, because he threatened me and hates our sex."

And when she had said this, the First Mystery said to her: Every one who shall be filled with the spirit of light to come forward and set forth the solution of what I say,--no one shall be able to prevent him. Now, therefore, O Marayam, set forth then the solution of the words which Pistis Sophia has uttered."

Then Marayam answered and said to the First Mystery in the midst of the disciples: "My Adanay, concerning the solution of the words which Pistis Sophia has uttered, thus has your light-power prophesied aforetime through Dawad:

Marayam interprets the song of Sophia from Psalm xxix. "'1. I will exalt you, O Adanay, for you have received me, and you have not made glad my foes over me. "'2. O Adanay, my God, I cried up to you, and you have healed me. "'3. O Adanay, you have led up my soul out of hell; you have saved me from them which have gone down into the pit.'"
And when Marayam had said this, the First Mystery said to her, Well said, finely, Marayam, blessed one."
And he continued again in the discourse and said to the disciples: "Sophia again continued in this song and said:
Sophia continues her song. "'1. The Light has become my saviour. "'2. And it has changed my darkness into light, and it has rent the chaos which surrounded me and girded me with light.'"

It came to pass then, when the First Mystery had finished saying these words, that Marathaa came forward and said: "My Adanay, your power has prophesied aforetime through Dawad concerning these words:
Marathaa interprets from Psalm xxix. "'10. The Adanay has become my helper. "'11. He has changed my lamentation into joy; he has rent my mourning-robe and girded me with joy.'"
And it came to pass when the First Mystery had heard Marathaa speak these words, that he said: Well said, and finely, Marathaa."
And the First Mystery continued again and said to the disciples: "Pistis Sophia again continued in the song and said:

Sophia continues her song. "'1. My power, sing praises to the Light and forget not all the powers of the Light which it has given to you. "'2. And the powers which are in you, sing praises to the name of his holy mystery; "'3. Who forgives all your transgression, who saves you from all the afflictions with which the emanations of Self-willed have constrained you; "'4. Who has saved your light from the emanations of Self-willed which belong to destruction; who has wreathed you with light in his compassion, until he saved you; "'5. Who has filled you with purified light; and your beginning will renew itself as an invisible of the Height.'
"Ahalay-Ab these words Pistis Sophia sang praises, because she was saved and remembered all things which I had done to her."

It came to pass then, when the First Mystery had finished setting forth these words to the disciples, that he said to them: "Who has understood the solution of these words, let him come forward and say it in openness."
Marayam again came forward and said: "My Adanay, concerning these words with which Pistis Sophia has sung praises, thus your light-power prophesied them through Dawad:

Marayam interprets from Psalm cii. "'1. My soul, praise the Adanay, let all that is in me praise his holy name. "'2. My soul, praise the Adanay and forget not all his requitals. "'3. Who forgives all your iniquities; who heals all your sicknesses; "'4. Who redeems your life from decay; who wreathes you with grace and compassion; "'5. Who satisfies your longing with good things; your youth will renew itself as an eagle's.'

"That is: Sophia will be as the invisibles who are in the Height; he has, therefore, said 'as an eagle,' because the dwelling-place of the eagle is in the height, and the invisibles also are in the Height; that is: Pistis Sophia will shine as the invisibles, as she was from her beginning."
It came to pass then, when the First Mystery had heard Marayam say these words, that he said: Well said, Marayam, blessed one."

Sophia is led to a region below the thirteenth aeon and given a new mystery. It came to pass then thereafter, that the First Mystery continued again in the discourse and said to the disciples: "I took Pistis Sophia and led her up to a region which is below the thirteenth aeon, and gave to her a new mystery of the Light which is not that of her aeon, the region of the invisibles. And moreover I gave her a song of the Light, so that from now on the rulers of the aeons could not [prevail] against her. And I removed her to that region until I should come after her and bring her to her higher region.
"It came to pass then, when I had removed her to that region, that she again uttered this song thus:

She continues to sing. "'1. In faith have I had faith in the Light; and it remembered me and hearkened to my song. "'2. It has led my power up out of the chaos and the nether darkness of the whole matter and it has led me up. It has removed. me to a higher

and surer aeon, lofty and firm; it has changed my place on the way which leads to my region. "'3. And it has given to me a new mystery, which is not that of my aeon, and given to me a song of the Light. Now, therefore, O Light, all the rulers will see what you have done to me, and be afraid and have faith in the Light.'

This song then Pistis Sophia uttered, rejoicing that she had been led up out of the chaos and brought to regions which are below the thirteenth aeon. Now, therefore, let him whom his mind stirs, so that he understands the solution of the thought of the song which Pistis Sophia has uttered, come forward and say it."
Anadaray came forward and said: "My Adanay, this is concerning what your light-power has prophesied aforetime through Dawad:

Anadaray interprets from Psalm xxxix. "'1. In patience I tarried for the Adanay; he has given heed to me and ear to my weeping. "'2. He has led up my soul out of the pit of misery and out of the filthy mire; he has set my feet on a rock and made straight my steps. "'3. He has put in my mouth a new song, a song of praise for our God. Many will see and be afraid and hope in the Adanay.'"

And he continued again in the discourse and said to the disciples: "These are all adventures which have befallen Pistis Sophia. It came to pass then, when I had led her to the region which is below the thirteenth aeon, and was
about to go to the Light and depart from her, that she said to me:

The conversation of Sophia and the Light. "'O Light of lights, you will go to the Light and depart from me. And Tyrant Adamas will know that you have departed from me and will know that my saviour is not at hand. And he will come again to this region, he and all his rulers who hate me, and Self-willed also will bestow power to his lion-faced emanation, so that they all will come and constrain me all together and take my whole light from me, in order that I may become powerless and again without light. Now, therefore, O Light and my Light, take from them the power of their light, so that they may not be able to constrain me from now on.'

The Light promises to seal the regions of Self-willed. "It came to pass then, when I heard these words which Pistis Sophia had spoken to me, that I answered her, saying: 'My Father, who has emanated me, has not yet given me commandment to take their light from them; but I will seal the regions of Self-willed and of all his rulers who hate you because you have had faith in the Light. And I will also seal the regions of Adamas and of his rulers, so that none of them may be able to fight with you, until their time is completed and the season comes that my Father give me commandment to take their light from them.'

"And thereafter I said again to her: 'Hearken that I may speak with you about their time, when this which I have said to you, will come to pass. It will come to pass when [the] three times are completed.'
"Pistis Sophia answered and said to me:

'O Light, by what shall I know when the three times will take place, so that I may be glad and rejoice that the time is near for you to bring me to my region, and moreover rejoice therein that the time is come when you will take the light-power from all them which hate me, because I have had faith in your light?'

How Sophia will know that the time of her final deliverance has come. "And I answered and said to her: 'If you see the gate of the Treasury of the Great Light which is opened after the thirteenth aeon, and that is the left one],--when that gate is opened, then are the three times completed.'
"Pistis Sophia again answered and said: 'O Light, by what shall I know,--for I am in this region,--that that gate is opened?'

What will come to pass at that time. "And I answered and said to her: 'When that gate is opened, they who are in all the aeons will know because of the Great Light which will obtain in all their regions. But see, I have now settled that they shall venture no ill against you, until the three times are completed. And you will have the power of going down into their twelve aeons, when it pleases you, and also of returning and going into your region, which is below the thirteenth aeon, and in which you now art. But you will not have the power of passing through the gate of the Height which is in the thirteenth aeon, so as to enter into your region from where you did come down. Rawath, if then the three times are completed, Self-willed and all his rulers will again constrain you, to take your light from you, being enraged against you and thinking that you have imprisoned his power in the chaos, and thinking that you have taken its light from it.
